_comment: Workbook exercise air-economizer (docs/workbook/air-economizer.md): the lbnl-sdahu config template with the economizer rules only. `camber datasets config lbnl-sdahu --exercise air-economizer --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. The unit's own design minimum OA (a 1.6% OA fraction at its fixed 10% minimum damper position) and its fixed 60 F dry-bulb high limit are the dataset template's (see configs/lbnl-sdahu.json); free_cooling_missed is added for the stuck-closed dampers, and leaking_valve is left to the air-heat-cool exercise. free_cooling_missed deliberately leaves out the unit's 33.8 F economizer low-limit lockout (low_limit_f, which the dataset template sets): step 5 of the exercise has learners read the fault-free unit's warn without it, find from the trends and the sequence that most of its missed hours are below the lockout, where the damper is held at its minimum by design, then add "low_limit_f": 33.8 to that rule's params and re-run.
